newsitem.title: USA: Handy & Harman says 3.9 mln shrs tendered.
newsitem.headline: Handy & Harman says 3.9 mln shrs tendered.

text.p: Handy & Harman on Friday said the preliminary count in its recently expired self-tender offer indicated that 3.9 million shares were tendered and not withdrawn at prices of $18.75 per share or lower.

Shares tendered in excess of this price will be promptly returned, the company said, noting that it expects to purchase 1,800,000 shares tendered at such price, or approximately 46% of the shares accepted for purchase in the offer.
The Company commenced the tender offer on Thursday, October 24, 1996, and ended it on November 21.
